title: Briefing Senate Intelligence Committee investigators unaware of facilities

tellings.quote: Now when I was briefing the senior investigators for Senate Intelligence Committee when I first started meeting with them, they didn't know we had these facilities.

plain: Senior investigators for the Senate Intelligence Committee did not know that the US had certain secret facilities until they were briefed. Steven Greer, a doctor who has long campaigned for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, tells Michels he did the briefing himself, which would mean such sites are hidden even from the people meant to oversee them.
